messages:
Alice M: Heads-up — we need marketing sign-off on the customer-facing status page copy and comms timing for the degraded-latency incident affecting some Dedicated clusters. Proposing two-phase comms: immediate status alert + a follow-up RCA within 48h. Draft below.

Alice M: ```
Status page (short): We're currently investigating increased request latency and intermittent timeouts for some Dedicated clusters in us-west-2. Our engineers are actively working to restore normal service. We will provide updates here every 30 minutes.

Follow-up (RCA teaser): A detailed postmortem will be published within 48 hours. Customers with Dedicated contracts will receive direct outreach from their CSMs with any impact specifics and mitigation steps.
```

Ben (Marketing): Agree on two-phase. Tone should be clear + calm. Avoid speculative causes in the short alert, call out region and service only. No SLA/legal language in the first update. Add short "what you can do" guidance if there's a recommended workaround. :thumbsup:

Jordan (CSM): For any affected Dedicated customers we should send a targeted email within 1 hour of the status alert. Include: incident summary, ETA for next update, support contact (csm or support@redwood.ai), and whether any customer action is required. I'll draft the email template once we confirm affected customer list.

Sam (Ops): Current ETA for mitigation is ~45 minutes for the batching regression rollback. I'll post a confirmation here when complete. We're tracking under INC-12345.

Ben (Marketing): Drafted short statuspage copy with optional "what you can do":

Ben (Marketing): ```
Short alert (final candidate): We are investigating increased latency and intermittent timeouts impacting Dedicated clusters in us-west-2. Engineers have identified a regression in request batching and are rolling back the change. Some requests may be delayed; normal service is expected within 60 minutes. Check this page for updates.

What you can do: If you have time-sensitive traffic, consider temporarily routing to a different region or using smaller batch sizes; contact support for assistance.
```

Ben (Marketing): Suggested targeted email subject lines: 
- "Redwood status: Investigating latency in us-west-2 Dedicated clusters"
- "Action recommended: Temporary latency in us-west-2 Dedicated clusters"

Jordan (CSM): Prefer the first subject unless we need customers to immediately act. I'll segment: customers with SLA/Dedicated > 4 nodes and any with active high-throughput jobs. Please confirm list — @Sam can you share affected tenant IDs?

Sam (Ops): Affected tenants posted to INC-12345; I'll DM the list to Jordan and product-ops. Can't paste IDs in public channel.

IncidentBot: [Incident update] 1832156890 — Mitigation started: rollback initiated by ops. Estimated time to recovery 35m.

Alice M: Ok, timeline looks good. Remaining asks: 1) Marketing to finalize the short status page copy (Ben) 2) Jordan to prepare targeted email template and segment list 3) Ops to confirm recovery or update ETA in 30 mins. We'll publish the short alert once ops confirms rollback started.

Ben (Marketing): Final short statuspage line (ready to publish on go): "We are investigating increased latency and intermittent timeouts impacting Dedicated clusters in us-west-2. Engineers have initiated a rollback of a recent batching change. We expect service to return to normal within ~60 minutes. Updates will be posted here."

Jordan (CSM): I'll prep the email and ready to send as soon as Ben posts the final copy. I'll include a CSM contact block and a link to open an incident-only support ticket.

Sam (Ops): Rollback finished — recovery confirmed at 1832156902. No further action required right now, monitoring for stability.

Alice M: Great — Ben please publish the status alert now, Jordan please send targeted emails to affected Dedicated customers. After we have stability for 48 hours we publish the RCA. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
